title: 第5章 先抓住男人的胃
slug: 前任渣我五年闪婚他哥被宠成宝
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时夏禾尴尬得头皮发麻。

她握紧手机，硬着头皮解释：“您别误会，我不是为了接您这单生意才跟前任分手。我是分手之后，才知道您这里需要人假结婚。”

祁晏辞神色没有半点波澜。

片刻后，他薄唇轻启。

“继续。”

时夏禾愣住：“什么？”

祁晏辞皱了下眉，似乎很讨厌别人听不懂他的话。

“语音。”

他冷声道：“点开，继续。”

时夏禾：“……”

她握着手机的手指僵住。

姜柠这张嘴，她太了解了。

她现在只希望姜柠别说出什么更离谱的话。

可祁晏辞就坐在对面看着她，意思很明显。

不听完，不算完。

时夏禾吞了吞喉咙，只能重新点开那条语音。

姜柠气急败坏的声音再次响起。

“这狗男人刚跟你分手就跟其他女人约会，这不是无缝衔接是什么？我气不过，刚才过去提醒了他一句，说我要把他带女人吃饭的事告诉你。”

“结果你猜他说什么？他说他是在工作，是你自己误会他、不肯信他。他每次都要跟你解释，这次不想解释了。怎么，骗你还有理了？”

“更恶心的是，我刚转身出来，就听见那女的问他，为什么要说是在工作，他们明明是在约会。阿禾，这种男人你分得太对了，脸是好看的，心是烂的！”

语音放完，餐厅里安静得可怕。

时夏禾的脸烧得厉害。

偏偏下一秒，手机又震了一下。

姜柠又发来一条语音。

时夏禾下意识抬头。

祁晏辞也正看着她。

那眼神冷冷淡淡，像是在说：继续。

时夏禾认命地点开。

姜柠这次声音低了些，带着明显的心疼。

“你们爱了那么多年，分手了你肯定很难过吧？我今天早点下班，晚上过去陪你喝一杯。”

时夏禾心口轻轻一颤。

姜柠是除了养母之外，少数真心惦记她的人。

她按住语音键回复：“我不难过，你不用来了。”

她确实已经不难过了。

对一个从头到尾都在骗她的人，她有什么好难过的？

她只是觉得不值。

五年的真心不值。

五年的血汗钱不值。

现在的她，只想做好眼下这份工作，拿到自己应得的报酬。

Page (1/3)

Shi Xiahe's scalp was numb with embarrassment.

She clenched her phone and explained forcefully: "Don't get me wrong, I didn't break up with my ex just to take over your business. It was only after we broke up that I realized you needed someone to get married here."

Qi Yanci's expression was calm.

After a moment, his thin lips opened slightly.

"Continue."

Shi Xiahe was stunned: "What?"

Qi Yanci frowned, as if he hated that others couldn't understand him.

"Voice."

He said coldly: "Click and continue."

Shi Xiahe: "..."

Her fingers holding the phone froze.

She knew Jiang Ning's mouth very well.

Now she just hoped that Jiang Ning wouldn't say anything more outrageous.

But Qi Yanci was sitting opposite and looking at her, his meaning was obvious.

It's not finished until you finish listening.

Shi Xiahe swallowed his throat and could only click on the voice message again.

Jiang Ning's furious voice sounded again.

"This bitch of a man dated other women right after he broke up with you. Isn't this a seamless transition? I was so angry that I just went over and reminded him that I was going to tell you about him taking women to dinner."

"In the end, what do you think he said? He said he was at work, but you misunderstood him and refused to believe him. He has to explain to you every time, but he doesn't want to explain this time. What, does it make sense to lie to you?"

"What's even more disgusting is that as soon as I turned around and came out, I heard the woman ask him why he said he was at work when they were obviously dating. Ah He, you are so right about this kind of man. He has a beautiful face but a rotten heart!"

After the audio was played, the restaurant was eerily quiet.

Shi Xiahe's face burned badly.

But the next second, the phone vibrated again.

Jiang Ning sent another voice message.

Shi Xiahe subconsciously raised his head.

Qi Yanci was also looking at her.

The eyes were cold and indifferent, as if to say: Continue.

Shi Xiahe accepted his fate and opened the door.

Jiang Ning's voice was lower this time, with obvious distress.

"You have been in love for so many years. You must be sad when we break up, right? I will get off work early today and go over to have a drink with you in the evening."

Shi Xiahe's heart trembled slightly.

Jiang Ning is one of the few people besides her adoptive mother who really cares about her.

She pressed the voice button and replied: "I'm not sad, you don't have to come."

She really wasn't sad anymore.

What should she feel bad about someone who lied to her from beginning to end?

She just didn't think it was worth it.

Five years of sincerity is not worth it.

Five years of hard-earned money is not worth it.

Now, she just wants to do her current job well and get the reward she deserves.
